kai: saw a weird case in staging: client triggers a toolcall, then client-side truncation, then a model-swap on resume and we end up with two separate confirmed charges for what felt like one user action. reproducible.

meera: can you paste the sanitized trace?

kai: sure: ```STREAM_START id=sess-7 model=gpt-std v1 seq=0
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=22 prefix=\"Hi\"
TOOLCALL start id=tool-42
TOOLCALL success id=tool-42 produced_tokens=14
CLIENT_TRUNCATE reason=conn_lost
LEDGER provisional tokens=36 sess=sess-7 note=partial
RECONNECT via router=us-west-2 session=sess-7-1 model=gpt-std v2
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=22 prefix=\"Hi\"
STREAM_CHUNK seq=2 tokens=10 prefix=\"there\"
LEDGER confirmed tokens=46 sess=sess-7-1 note=resume_confirm
```

jon: interesting: provisional 36 then confirmed 46 -> delta 10 which matches additional tokens produced after resume, but provisional never got cleared so invoice shows 36 + 46 = 82.

pat: guess: confirm path created a fresh confirmed row instead of absorbing provisional. model-swap on resume complicates dedupe because confirm includes model version tag and we still treat as distinct session lineage.

meera: two fixes: 1) continuity_token on provisional writes and propagate on resume; confirm path tries attach-by-continuity first. 2) prefix_fingerprint on each chunk to allow fuzzy attach when continuity missing.

kai: + add model-agnostic attach rules: if continuity token absent, allow attach even if model differs, provided prefix_fingerprint matches and confirmed_tokens <= provisional_tokens * 1.15 (tolerance). log anomaly when models differ.

jon: DB pattern: provisional rows store continuity_token, prefix_fingerprint, produced_tokens, created_at. Confirm attach uses SELECT FOR UPDATE provisional WHERE continuity_token = X OR (prefix_fingerprint = Y AND created_at > now()-T) LIMIT 1; mark provisional.attached_by=confirm_id in same txn. Avoid double-attach with CAS.

pat: caution: FOR UPDATE could impact throughput if abused. keep TTL short (e.g., 2m) and index. We'll add a lightweight in-memory fast-path: router checks local cache for continuity_token first to avoid DB hit.

meera: console asks: show provisional rows per workspace and a small diff UI (provisional vs confirmed). ops need a button to request refund/dispute and a link to the trace. create a canary toggle "provisional-aware billing" so support can preview reconciled totals.

kai: telemetry: emit metrics provisional.count, attach.success_rate, unmatched_confirm.count, model_mismatch_attach.count. create a billing-reconciliation dashboard and a panel for unmatched_confirm over time.

jon: alerting: page on-call if unmatched_confirm.rate > 5/min for > 10m OR if attach.success_rate < 90% for 15m. Rate-limit paging for noisy customers.

pat: rollout plan: feature-flag continuity_token + attach logic. Start 1% traffic in non-prod region, then 5% in canary. Run reconcile job that backfills attachments for orphan provisionals older than TTL using fuzzy-match.

meera: small UX: mark session rows with a yellow "provisional" pill and a tooltip: "Tentative tokens — will reconcile on session resume". clicking opens trace and shows continuity_token if present.

kai: i'll own the telemetry and the incident runbook. jon will PR DB schema + attach txn. meera will own console mockups + ticket. pat will add router header propagation for continuity_token.

ledger-bot: ticket created LEDGER-409 "Provisional attach by continuity_token + reconciliation" assigned: jon, pat

console-bot: ticket created CONS-2201 "Provisional billing preview + trace links" assigned: meera, support

kai: thanks — aim for canary next week. if anyone sees a customer escaltion drop it here and we'll bump rollout.
